environment.description: Application deployed on EC2 instance behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer) in AWS. The NLB operates at Layer 4 (TCP) and passes traffic directly to the application on port 8080. No additional middleware or proxy sits between the NLB and the Flask application. Security groups allow inbound TCP/443 from 0.0.0.0/0 to the NLB and TCP/8080 from the NLB to the instance. The application runs as a systemd service with default permissions.

config.security_groups: inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0 -> NLB; inbound 8080 from NLB SG -> EC2
config.monitoring: CloudWatch agent for CPU/memory metrics only
